I am a Sunni Muslim. I met a wife of a non-Muslim. She was physically tortured by her husband. To get rid of that situation, I helped her. Her husband came to know. Situation became worse. Ultimately, they got divorced. In between, I fall in love with her and commit illegal sexual intercourse with her 3-4 times. After that I felt the guilt. In the shake of that, I became religious and ask forgiveness from Allah. She reverted to Muslim and became religious too. We both got 100 lashes as per hadith each. I want to marry her so that Allah may forgive both of us for the gravest sin. But my family is in strict opposition. Her parents have no objection. To perform Namaz and Roza and to follow Islam, she is staying in hostel. If she returns to her home, she cannot follow Islam. She has no earnings. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 35955 Country: Pakistan Title: Calling wife mother by mistake? Question: I need to ask about this if I have mistakenly called my wife 'meri maa' does that effect nikah? Answer ID: 35955 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 93/71/B=1433) It will not have any effect on your nikah; however it is makrooh to say like this. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
